notes: Access: direct HTTP GET (Shopify storefront), no block encountered, tier-1 sufficient throughout. robots.txt fetched and scanned for ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/anthropic-ai/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot: none present (standard Shopify boilerplate only, disallows admin/cart/checkout/search paths, no Claude-specific group) -> not blocked, proceeded. Tree source: enumerated the full collection catalogue via /collections.json?limit=250 (page1=250, page2=125, total=375) and cross-verified against /sitemap_collections_1.xml (also exactly 375 <loc> entries, identical set) -> complete coverage confirmed, no missed collections. Filtered all 375 for bath/shower/toilet/vanity/faucet/sink/basin/bidet/tub/mirror keywords: Bouclair is a Canadian home-decor/textile retailer and sells NO plumbing fixtures (no toilets, sinks, tubs, faucets, basins) and no bathroom-specific mirror collection (its mirror collections are general wall-decor-and-mirrors, junior/nursery variants, unrelated to bathroom). Candidate bath collections found: bath-mats, bath-towels, bathroom-accessories, bathroom-decor, bathroom-furniture, bathroom-wall-decor, shower-curtains, newest-bath-accessories, bed-and-bath, plus promo/sale pages (bed-bath-sale, obp-bed-bath, bed-bath-storage-25-off, bedding-bath-and-storage, view-all-bed-and-bath) excluded as promotional/View-All per rule 25. Qty verification: rendered-HTML embedded 'theme.stores.totalCount' was checked first but returned the identical value (52) on every single collection page regardless of actual contents -> identified as a fixed per-page grid-size setting, not a real count, and discarded. Used /collections/<handle>/products.json paginated (limit=250) counting unique product IDs instead, which varied correctly per collection and matched canonical/h1 verification on each page (page is client-rendered with no static Enumerable is data + no product cards in raw HTML, confirming products.json as the only reliable source here). Classification per bathroom.md: bathroom-accessories (7: storage tray, ceramic soap dispenser, rubber-coated tumbler, extendable bath caddy, toilet brush) and bathroom-furniture (9: towel holders, toilet paper holders, towel racks, stool) are clean, genuinely bathroom-hardware/furniture listings -> recorded as rows. Exclusions/routing: bath-mats (6, all fabric/tufted/braided mats, no rubber/anti-slip), bath-towels (25), and shower-curtains (2) are textile-primary per rules 15/16/20 -> checked cross_category_url_index.json, all 3 already recorded in Textile.xlsx -> routed to review as ALREADY EXTRACTED. bathroom-wall-decor (3: 'Set of 3 Wall Hooks on Plaque', 'Man & Woman Silhouette Bathroom Shadow Box', 'Get Naked Printed Canvas') is majority wall-art per rule 21 (2 of 3 are art/shadow-box pieces); not found in Wall_Decor.xlsx's index -> sent to review for adjudication rather than guessed. bathroom-decor (117) inspected product-by-product via products.json titles: a mixed merchandising collection combining Storage-owned items (baskets/trays/waste bins/hampers/trunks, ~half the list), Textile-owned items (hand/bath towels, washcloths, bath mats), and genuine Bathroom items (soap dispensers, toilet brush, wall hooks, shower liner) under one flat URL with no further site subcategorization -> per rules 29/30-33 (ambiguity + no crossover re-extraction + no aggregation) this is not a clean single-category leaf, sent to review flagged MIXED rather than recorded wholesale or partially estimated. newest-bath-accessories (21, 'Newest Bathroom Accessories') is a New-Arrivals filtered feed duplicating bathroom-accessories/bathroom-decor content -> excluded as promotional per rule 25, noted in review. bed-and-bath (148) is the broad parent Bed+Bath landing collection, a superset of the above -> excluded per rule 24 (never record parent when subcategories exist), noted in review. Dedup: 3 URLs (bath-mats, bath-towels, shower-curtains) matched Textile.xlsx via cross_category_url_index.json.
